  unless Uorc.Uorc.Core.HeapMovedTests.overflowScenario do throw (IO.userError "overflowScenario failed")
  unless Uorc.Uorc.Core.HeapMovedTests.preflightScenario do throw (IO.userError "preflightScenario failed")

# Read-only structural probe of official SDK semantic nodes, not allocator telemetry.
import json,subprocess,sys,hashlib,copy
from pathlib import Path
source=Path(sys.argv[1]);baseline=Path('/workspace/heap-moved-before/Heap.semantic.json')
j=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['/workspace/heap-delivery/export-semantic-json',str(source)]))
defs={x['name']:x for x in j['declarations'] if x['kind']=='definition'}
old={x['name']:x for x in json.loads(baseline.read_text())['declarations'] if x['kind']=='definition'}
def walk(x):
 if isinstance(x,dict):
  yield x
  for v in x.values():yield from walk(v)
 elif isinstance(x,list):
  for v in x:yield from walk(v)
def calls(n,fn):return [x for x in walk(defs[n]['body']) if x.get('kind')=='call' and x['function'].get('name')==fn]
for n in ['allocate','dropRetainedRoot','preflightMovedRoots']:
 assert defs[n]==old[n],n+' changed'
assert len(calls('allocate','retainEntry'))==2
assert len(calls('allocate','writeIndex'))==1
assert len(calls('retainEntry','writeIndex'))==1
assert len(calls('dropRetainedRoot','writeIndex'))==1
fused=bool(calls('allocateMoved','allocateMovedChecked'))
if fused:
 assert len(calls('allocateMovedChecked','attachMovedChild'))==2
 assert len(calls('allocateMovedChecked','writeIndex'))==1
 assert len(calls('attachMovedChild','writeIndex'))==1
 assert len(calls('attachMovedChild','retainEntry'))==1
 assert not calls('allocateMoved','dropRetainedRoot')
 assert not calls('allocateMovedChecked','dropRetainedRoot')
 # Restore only the three intentional body differences, then compare the
 # entire guard/insertion tree to unchanged allocate, preserving order.
 normalized=copy.deepcopy(defs['allocateMovedChecked']['body'])
 old_delta=[x for x in walk(old['allocate']['body']) if x.get('kind')=='record' and x.get('type',{}).get('name')=='Delta']
 assert len(old_delta)==1
 old_fields={x['field']:x['value'] for x in old_delta[0]['fields']}
 seen=[]
 for node in walk(normalized):
  if node.get('kind')=='call' and node['function'].get('name')=='attachMovedChild':
   args=node['arguments'];assert len(args)==4
   seen.append(args[2].get('name'))
   node['function']={'name':'retainEntry'}
   node['arguments']=[args[0],args[1],{'kind':'bool','value':False}]
  elif node.get('kind')=='record' and node.get('type',{}).get('name')=='Delta':
   for field in node['fields']:
    if field['field'] in ['droppedRoots','work']:field['value']=copy.deepcopy(old_fields[field['field']])
 assert sorted(seen)==['moveFirst','moveSecond']
 assert normalized==old['allocate']['body'],'allocation guard/insertion tree changed'
 outer=copy.deepcopy(defs['allocateMoved']['body'])
 def preflight_match(body):
  matches=[x for x in walk(body) if x.get('kind')=='match' and x.get('scrutinee',{}).get('kind')=='call' and x['scrutinee']['function'].get('name')=='preflightMovedRoots']
  assert len(matches)==1,'move preflight missing or duplicated'
  return matches[0]
 old_outer=preflight_match(old['allocateMoved']['body'])
 new_outer=preflight_match(outer)
 old_ok=[x for x in old_outer['branches'] if x['constructor']['name']=='Result.ok'][0]
 new_ok=[x for x in new_outer['branches'] if x['constructor']['name']=='Result.ok'][0]
 assert new_ok['body']['kind']=='call' and new_ok['body']['function']['name']=='allocateMovedChecked'
 new_ok['body']=copy.deepcopy(old_ok['body'])
 assert outer==old['allocateMoved']['body'],'release/preflight guard order changed'
else:
 assert len(calls('allocateMoved','allocate'))==1
 assert len(calls('allocateMoved','dropRetainedRoot'))==2
controls=[('single_moved',1,1,2),('distinct_moved',2,2,3),('twice_aliased_two_tickets',2,2,3),('moved_and_unmoved_alias',2,1,3)]
rows=[{'control':n,'full_depth_index_writes':1+k+(0 if fused else m),'expected':e} for n,k,m,e in controls]
receipt={'schema':'uorc/heap-moved-structural-source-gate/1','source_sha256':hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'gate_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'official_semantic_parser':'read_module + byte-exact write_module roundtrip','kind':'structural source-call counts; not runtime allocator telemetry','unchanged':['allocate','dropRetainedRoot','preflightMovedRoots'],'controls':rows,'passed':all(r['full_depth_index_writes']==r['expected'] for r in rows)}
print(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2));sys.exit(0 if receipt['passed'] else 1)
